subject: Ad-hoc audit log access & export playbook for legal hold
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@medicorps.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: LegalOps <legalops@medicorps.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Nov 2028 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: Request: audit/access log export + retention confirmation for legal hold

Hi Grace,

We have a legal hold that just came down for a subset of our environment (tenant id: MC-7732). Legal needs a full export of audit and access logs for the last 24 months for users in scope, plus confirmation of what is retained vs tombstoned. Questions:
- What are Redwood's default retention windows for audit vs access logs on Hosted?
- Can you export deleted events or only live/retained records?
- What export formats do you support (CSV/JSON/Parquet)?
- Is there an expedited path (SLA) for production legal holds and an estimated turnaround?
- Any residency or cross-border considerations we should be aware of for data originating in us-west-2?

We attached the legal hold notice (see LegalOps). Appreciate a high-level playbook — we may need to escalate if we have to involve our procurement/security teams.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Morales
Sr. Security Program Manager
MediCorps Health

Attachments: legal_hold_notice_MC-7732.pdf (referenced)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@medicorps.com>
Cc: LegalOps <legalops@medicorps.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Nov 2028 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: audit/access log export + retention confirmation for legal hold

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up and the notice. Summary below and a short playbook attached. I marked expected SLAs based on your plan (Hosted vs Dedicated).

Quick answers up front:
- Retention (Hosted): default audit-access logs are retained 90 days for standard Hosted plans. For customers on Dedicated or Private we support configurable retention up to multi-year (we've done 7+ years for enterprise customers under contract).
- Deleted events: if an event was deleted but still within the configured retention window it will be present in exports. If it has been purged per retention policy, we cannot recover it.
- Formats: exports available as newline-delimited JSON (NDJSON) and compressed Parquet for bulk exports; CSV available for small slices via ad-hoc API.
- SLA / turnaround: standard ad-hoc export turnaround is 48–72 hours. We offer an expedited export (enterprise SLA) with 4–8 hour turnaround for customers with an active support commitment — will require an approved escalation and may incur a fee.
- Residency: data for your tenant in us-west-2 will be exported from that region by default. We can provide region-bound signed S3 URLs for delivery to your S3 (same region preferred). Cross-border transfers are only performed if you request them explicitly.

What I'll do next (playbook summary):
1) Confirm scope with you (tenant id, start/end timestamps, principals).
2) Run preflight to check retention state and estimate volume.
3) Produce export in NDJSON + Parquet, include an event manifest and index (hashes).
4) Deliver via signed S3 URL (or our secure transfer endpoint) and provide checksum/manifest.
5) If you need redaction/pseudonymization before delivery, we can run a redaction pass (longer turnaround).

I've attached our Audit Export Runbook (audit_export_runbook_v1.pdf) which includes required authorizer steps, evidence manifest template, and the escalation path. If you need the expedited SLA, please confirm and we'll route to our SOC and SalesOps for approval.

FYI I'm cc'ing Karthik — he'll confirm contract/retention entitlements and assist with the delivery cadence.

Regards,
Grace O'Connor
Customer Reliability Lead — Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachment: audit_export_runbook_v1.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Nov 2028 11:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: Re: MedCorps legal hold — confirm entitlement and next steps

Grace — quick clarifying questions before I commit to an expedited path:
- Do we have MC-7732 on Dedicated/Private or Hosted? (Elena asked but not mentioned in the notice.)
- Does the customer's contract include the expedited export SLA or will we need a one-off operational fee?
- For exports that include deleted events, confirm that our S3 output includes tombstone markers and the original event timestamps.
- KMS: do they have a customer-managed KMS key for exports, or should we use Redwood-managed encryption? Need to avoid rekeying delays.

Marissa — can you pull the HubSpot record and confirm plan & entitlements? If they are Hosted and need 24+ months of data but haven't retained, we should flag potential gaps to Elena.

-Karthik

Quoted:
> On Thu, Nov 30, 2028 at 10:03 AM Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com> wrote:
> > Summary below and a short playbook attached. I marked expected SLAs based on your plan (Hosted vs Dedicated).

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Nov 2028 14:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Internal: MedCorps legal hold — plan info and delivery options

Thanks — pulled the account: HubSpot id 98765 (link below). MedCorps is on a Dedicated plan (standard committed pool) with an addendum for 5-year retention for audit logs (see contract section 5.2). They have Redwood-managed KMS by default; customer has not enabled a CMK.

Implications and next steps:
- Since they are Dedicated with a 5-year retention addendum, we should be able to produce the 24-month export in the standard exported formats without missing windows.
- We can do expedited export under the enterprise ops SLA; finance will need to approve a nominal fee (quote ~USD 2,500 for the expedited rush — I'll open a request).
- Delivery options: signed S3 URL (preferred), or we can push to their tenant SFTP endpoint. Signed URL will be region-bound to us-west-2 to satisfy residency.
- I'll attach the evidence manifest template (medicorps_evidence_manifest.xlsx) and confirm the HubSpot support ticket (SUP-9821) to track the runbook and approvals.

I'll loop in SupportOps as soon as Elena confirms scope and whether they want expedited handling.

-Marissa

Related links:
